subject: Inter-portal evidence harmonization request — Vendr + OneTrust mapping
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <liam@brightleaf.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: support@vendr.com, integrations@onetrust.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: cross-portal evidence mapping for SOC2/CAIQ

Hi Marcus,

Quick note from BrightLeaf's security team — we're finalizing vendor profiles and want a single canonical mapping of evidence across Vendr and OneTrust for the SOC 2 and CAIQ items. Right now the same proof (e.g., S3 syslog export) appears in both portals under different filenames and owners, which is causing confusion in our procurement review.

Can Redwood provide:
- a short manifest that normalizes which artifacts map to which CAIQ/SIG controls,
- the canonical owner for each artifact, and
- a recommended TTL/rotation schedule for temporary proofs (log exports, screenshots).

We'd like to close this by EOD next Wednesday if possible. Attaching our current portal export for reference (lightweight).

Thanks,
Liam
Security Program Manager
BrightLeaf Finance

Attachment: brightleaf_portal_export_v2.csv (attachment stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Vendr Portal <support@vendr.com>, OneTrust Integrations <integrations@onetrust.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: cross-portal evidence mapping for SOC2/CAIQ

Liam — thanks for the note and the export. We can absolutely produce a normalized manifest. Proposed approach: 

1) We generate a "portal harmonization manifest" (spreadsheet) that lists each artifact, the CAIQ/SIG control(s) it supports, the Redwood canonical filename, and the owner (team + email).
2) We will identify duplicates across Vendr and OneTrust and recommend which entry to keep as primary (with a short justification column).
3) For temporary artifacts (logs/screenshots), we'll propose TTLs and an automation step to archive proofs to an S3 snapshot with signed proofs (hash + timestamp).

Action items / timeline: I can circulate the first draft by Monday EOD. Mina will own the mapping work and Lauren will validate retention/archival steps. Aditya will confirm S3 proof retention mechanics and provide the hash manifest sample.

If that works, we'll attach the draft manifest and a CAIQ<->SIG mapping for your reviewers.

Best,
Marcus
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: portal_harmonization_template.xlsx (placeholder)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connell <liam@brightleaf.com>, Vendr Portal <support@vendr.com>, OneTrust Integrations <integrations@onetrust.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: cross-portal evidence mapping for SOC2/CAIQ

Folks — quick status update and a couple clarification questions: 

- I've started the manifest and attached an initial sheet (evidence_manifest_v1.xlsx). It contains three tabs: raw exports, normalized artifacts, and recommended primary entries.
- Q1 for BrightLeaf: when you say "canonical owner" do you prefer a Redwood team contact (e.g., "Security Ops — security@redwood.ai") or a named individual? We recommend team-owned entries for long-term maintainability.
- Q2 for Vendr/OneTrust: do either portals support a stable external_id we can rely on for deduping? If so, include the field name and we'll map against it.

Next steps: I'll incorporate portal stable ids (if provided) and run a dedupe pass. Plan to push updated manifest and CAIQ/SIG mapping by EOD today.

Thanks,
Mina
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence_manifest_v1.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connell <liam@brightleaf.com>, Vendr Portal <support@vendr.com>, OneTrust Integrations <integrations@onetrust.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: cross-portal evidence mapping for SOC2/CAIQ

Adding a quick technical note — we run a nightly inventory job that stores signed manifest snapshots to s3://redwood-evidence-snapshots/brightleaf/ with object metadata containing sha256 and uploaded_by. I can produce a short script that: 

- pulls the portal export files,
- computes sha256,
- uploads to the s3 snapshot bucket with a JSON metadata file linking the object to CAIQ control ids and Redwood canonical filename.

I'll draft that script and include the sample hash manifest in the updated evidence_manifest_v1.xlsx. For BrightLeaf: once we agree on primary entries, we can provide a read-only presigned URL list for your reviewers.

Next steps (summary):
- Mina: finalize normalized manifest + recommended primaries (EOD today)
- Aditya: attach sample hash manifest and s3 upload script snippet (by EOD)
- Marcus / Lauren: confirm TTL/retention defaults (7 days for ephemeral screenshots; 365 days for syslog snapshots)

I'll attach the CAIQ<->SIG draft mapping in the next message.

Cheers,
Aditya
Platform Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: caiq-sig_map_draft.md, portal_owner_matrix.csv
